newsitem.title: USA: KLS Enviro unable to meet rig demand.
newsitem.headline: KLS Enviro unable to meet rig demand.

text.p: KLS Enviro Resources Inc said on Friday it was unable to meet customer demand for its mining exploration rigs due to increasing global exploration for precious metals.
But the company said it expected, with its strategic plan for more rigs for 1997, the situation would change.
For the year ended September 30, the company reported total sales and revenues from continuing operations of $4.42 million, up 47 percent from last year.
KLS said the increase was due to increased drilling revenues in both Mexico and Alaska, and an increase in the number of drilling rigs in operation.
The company has nine drilling rigs under contract and said it expected to sizeably increase the number of rigs this calendar year, with an additional four rigs by March.
